comparison.objective: Lay two cables in a cable carrier in the required order and latch every crossbar.
comparison.physical_skill: Route flexible cables without crossing or riding side plates, then press multiple snap catches closed.
comparison.success_condition: Both cables occupy every link in order, all crossbars are genuinely latched, ends protrude sufficiently, and hands release.
comparison.reason: Flexible routing and repeated snap-latching do not exercise flush rail continuation, precision block sliding, or free rolling-element retention. No missing rubric detail prevents distinction.
